title: Expose typed float guide readback through the graph debug capture surface
body: The temporal depth witness needed original R32F bytes, but Debug/RenderTargetReadback.h only exposed RGBA8/BGRA8-to-PNG capture and assumed four bytes per texel. This lane extracts raw readback, adds the depth/motion format byte sizes, and keeps color PNG capture as a wrapper. Derive supported formats and inspection views from resource declarations rather than each guide lane adding bespoke readback plumbing. Tier luna: shared readback API and multi-format validation.

title: Resolve mapped Windows paths before the codegen WSL bridge
body: The native configure completed despite wslpath failing on Z:/... mapped worktree paths, leaving empty codegen input/output arguments (native-configure-dependency-trust.log). This lane resolves each Windows mapped drive to its UNC share before calling wslpath, uses wsl --cd /, and fails configuration on a nonzero or empty translation. Preserve that platform input conversion in the common consumer setup, with a native mapped-drive guard witness. Tier luna: a platform path bridge and its native configure/check validation.

title: Derive graph guide hazards from reflected SDI resource access
body: ReconstructionDepth and ReconstructionExposure already declare read-only buffers and write-only images in reflected SDI. To make the real graph schedule them correctly, the lane must still pre-register BufferSyncGatherer/ImageSyncGatherer slots and manually connect BUFFER_READ_ARRAY, BUFFER_WRITE_ARRAY, and IMAGE_WRITE_ARRAY, including the exposure reducer write. Synthesize these hazard declarations from SDI member access plus provider resource identities; keep only the mathematical guide declaration authored. Tier sol: scheduler and reflection integration with cross-pass correctness tests.

title: Avoid MSVC PCH path case folding on mapped case-sensitive WSL worktrees
body: Native Core failed C1083 on lowercased vbvs--vixen and libraries/core/cmakefiles PCH paths in native-inputs-build.log; disabling ccache reproduced it in native-core-no-cache.log. The supported -DUSE_PRECOMPILED_HEADERS=OFF option made native-no-pch-core.log pass. Native setup should derive a case-safe PCH location or select this setting automatically for WSL-mapped case-sensitive sources. Tier luna, effort M: platform-specific CMake provisioning with a native fixture.

title: Make Windows platform macro definitions independent of optional PCH
body: After using the supported no-PCH build route, native-global-no-pch-build.log failed in SdiVariantMerge.cpp:250 with C2589/C2059 because windows.h max expanded std::max. NOMINMAX was only in Core/include/Headers.h, reached through PCH. Define NOMINMAX for Windows C++ in the root CMake contract and guard the header fallback. Platform definitions should be declared once and work with either PCH mode. Tier luna, effort M: compiler configuration plus native validation.

title: Declare shader compiler mutex dependency without relying on SDK headers
body: Native no-PCH compilation failed in ShaderCompiler.cpp:15 and :26 with C2039 for std::mutex and std::lock_guard (native-no-pch-platform-build.log). The file used these types while including only fstream directly; Linux SDK transitive includes hid the omission. Add the direct mutex include and keep an MSVC no-PCH compile witness. Tier haiku, effort S: a direct include plus native validation.

title: Select a native compiler-cache route for WSL-mapped build trees
body: The queued native-empty-nominmax-build on this assigned WSL worktree spent ~3 minutes per observed ccache process with ~15 CPU seconds and no active cl process at a snapshot (native-process-progress.json). Cache storage was also on the mapped WSL tree. I explicitly stopped four verified lane ccache PIDs and resumed the same CMake target with CCACHE_DISABLE=1 in a separate fixed script; the four interrupted files then compiled and dependency libraries linked (native-cache-bypass-build.log). Provision a cache location/strategy suitable for this native source route, or derive cache bypass when needed; preserve queue child cleanup. Tier luna, effort M: native cache provisioning and a bounded native compile fixture.

title: Declare per-query ray footprints instead of shader-global LOD overrides
body: Native authoritative picking must remain unjittered at display resolution while visual primary rays use the internal resolution. The shared traversal currently reads pc.raySizeCoef everywhere, so upscaleinputs had to add VIXEN_QUERY_RAY_SIZE_COEF plus a mutable per-invocation coefficient around the separate picking query. Consolidate the query sampling footprint as declared traversal input and generate its backend spelling. Tier sol, effort M: shared traversal ABI and native pixel parity across several consumers.

title: Derive declared instance streams and their frame-ring upload wiring
body: The motion record is declared once as BodyInstanceMotion.cs, but the instance uploader still needed handwritten extraction from host rows, another optional PerFrameResources ring, grow/capacity checks, sorted-row correspondence, per-frame copies and an output binding. These are incidental scaffolding around the declared previous-transform data. Derive the stream uploader and graph resource from schema-owned stream/lifetime facets, preserving the current 96-byte transform stream for bucketing, culling and specialized shading. Tier sol, effort M: schema-to-renderer ownership and allocation derivation.

title: Derive history write acknowledgements and viewport resets from group contracts
body: The history module declares its images and reset resources, but VulkanGraphApplication::Render still has to find the private seed/state nodes by string, compare a submission serial after a successful frame, and acknowledge the write. Host cut/activation entry points also locate the state node manually. Declare the viewport history owner, successful writer and cut/switch inputs once on the group; derive acknowledgement/reset wiring and handle-safe lifecycle behavior. Tier sol, effort M: group lifecycle semantics across recording, submission and graph cleanup.
